title: Please don't show user ID and/or password in event logs
body:
**Problem**
Helping people on facebook, we often ask them to show their logs.  Sometimes, their Nightscout ID and password shows in the logs.   We ask them to delete it.  But, those could already have been exposed to eyes that should have seen them.


**Solution**
Please identify all instances where a user ID or password is included in event logs.  Please replace the actual ID and password with words ID and Password.
